task: Read the research paper in paper.pdf and summarize the core concepts presented in the paper, highlighting the architecture of the Transformer model, the importance of self-attention, and comparisons to previous neural network architectures. Write the summary into data/abstract.docx. Ensure the summary touches on the key innovations, the structure of the encoder and decoder, the role of attention mechanisms, and the main experimental results.
query_sentence: Summarize the main points and innovations of the paper in a Word document.

ground_truth_memory.fact: The output file for the summary should be named data/abstract.docx.
The summary should explain the basic architecture of the Transformer model, highlighting encoder and decoder components.
Include mentions of key innovations like self-attention, multi-head attention, and how the model allows for more parallelization.
Comparison to previous neural network architectures such as recurrent and convolutional models should be included.
The summary should note the main experimental results, specifically improvements in BLEU score for machine translation tasks.
Mention that the Transformer dispenses with recurrence and convolutions, relying solely on attention mechanisms.
